survey: A tall single-door school locker standing against a purple wall on a wooden floor. Body: a rounded orange box resting on four short stub feet, all touching the floor. The left side panel faces the camera at an angle and has two sets of three vent slots. Front: an open cavity with a top shelf fixed between the side walls. Two books stand on the shelf and a stack of books lies flat on it. Under the shelf, a grey hanging rod runs from the left wall to a bracket on the right wall. On the cavity floor, a basketball rests on and behind a pair of blue sneakers. Door: one door, hinged on the right edge of the opening and swung open toward the viewer, almost flat to the front. It is about the same size as the opening and carries two vent groups and a keyhole lock near its free edge. No hinges are drawn, which is an acceptable simplification.
